note: What the board prints on a duty's two action boxes, and the only place it is written down. `name` is the duty action's NAME and goes top-left on the artwork; `shortLabel` is WHAT IT DOES and goes bottom-left. generate_action_board.py reads this at build time and geometry.py's DUTIES carries no copy -- tests/layout_lab/test_duty_text.py holds it to that.
casing: Stored as written and uppercased by CSS, so it stays usable somewhere quieter. A `name` is a label and takes Title Case; a `shortLabel` is a sentence and takes sentence case, with proper nouns -- Abbey, Special Activities, the Alms table -- kept. Never store it already shouting.
theX: The literal X is a stand-in for a number that depends on majority, and it is what the card shows while the layout is being composed. `byStrength` holds the real wording per duty strength; Duties.md gives majority value 2, parity 1, minority 1. Only Devotion is filled in -- an effect need not scale with the duty value, and a guessed number on a card is worse than an honest X.
singleAction: Taxation and Allocation have ONE action, so `actionB` is null. The lab draws no right artwork box for them and the ribbon card lists one row; nothing else moves, because nothing in this layout cascades.
joinsOn: `engineAction` is an id from docs/rules/DutyTiles.md under Canonical Action Names, and is the only thread to the engine. tests/layout_lab/test_duty_text.py fails if an id here is not in that table.
filling: A null `name` is an open question; a null `actionB` means the duty has one action. `unresolved` records a question about the DUTY rather than its wording.
controlsNote: The three marks in the controls column at the end of the action row, in the order geometry.py's MARKS_ORDER gives them -- Show Map, Hire Building, and the commit. They are BUTTONS, not duty actions: there is no engineAction and no byStrength, because pressing one is not a move the engine scores. `name` is what the mark's title says and what the icon lab labels its card with; `shortLabel` is what the mark does, and nothing prints it yet -- it is here because a mark with no caption still needs somewhere to say what it is for, and the three labels were a JS object typed into action_board.html.tmpl before this block existed, which is the exact fault this file was created to end.
